teaser: Chainguard mapped from OS to agents, its public feeds counted, and the context layer above the package where an open policy and a vault fit.
core_idea: Chainguard builds hardened software from the operating system up to agents and publishes open data, 12,480 advisories over 12,125 CVEs with a status per component, but its analysis stops at the package: of 2,850 recorded not-applicable decisions only 177 give a context reason, and current public records carry no reason at all; deciding which images must be fixed and which can ship today needs a context layer from the user story through the code to the container, written as a policy row per image, which is where open behaviour policies for its new agent products, sgit vaults for data between stages and an open format for deployment decisions plug in.
